RETIRED with the Q12 window track as an accepted residual, which is how it was filed. The remaining exposure is that bash cannot open O_NOFOLLOW and '<>' always creates, so a racer winning the window between the Python helper and the bash open can make root's source.forward CREATE an empty file at a chosen path. It is then detected and the run fails closed by name; arbitrary truncate, append, chown and chmod at root are all already eliminated. The only principal that can win that race is the controller identity, which the design already trusts to hold the window lock and own every run-root artifact. Closing it fully is structural — move the lock open into the Python helper and hand the descriptor back to bash, which the current shape cannot express — and source-recovery has completed, so the code path is not scheduled to run again. REOPEN CONDITION: reopen before any further privileged source.forward run, or if the wrapper is rewritten in a language that can express the descriptor handoff.

Fixed by making the predicate mean what its own error message says. assertRepositoryMigrationFrontier refused every non-chain history row newer than APPROVED_HISTORY_FRONTIER, whether or not the row came from a reviewed migration in this repository - so the guard was structurally unable to survive its own project, and the four migrations applied on 2026-08-12 were simply the first to trip it. 'Unknown' is the load-bearing word: a history row whose name matches a repository migration file is in Git and reviewed, so it now passes; a row matching nothing on disk is the unreviewed history the anchor exists to catch, and still fails. The anchor itself is untouched, so this is not a contract change - all five existing tests still pass unchanged, including 'refuses unknown history strictly NEWER than the frontier' and 'refuses a version strictly BETWEEN the frontier and the first chain version'. A new test pins the accepted case. Verified against live history rather than mocks: run against the real database, the check now returns an applied chain prefix of 5 where it would previously have thrown.

Both hypotheses in the ticket are disproved, and so is the framing. A probe against the deployed dev API shows a query and a mutation given the same bogus token return byte-identical 401s, so the message 'Authentication required. Please provide a valid Bearer token.' says nothing about whether the header arrived. It cannot: createContext has five paths returning an unauthenticated context and four were silent, including the one that discards the error from supabase.auth.getUser - a network call to GoTrue. A transient auth-service failure and a malformed token were indistinguishable to the caller, which is exactly the shape of a fault that hits one poll and nothing else. The true 2026-07-03 cause is no longer recoverable (logs long gone) and would need a paid live run to reproduce, so instead: (1) those branches now log which one fired, with the auth error and status, never the token, so a recurrence names its own cause; (2) the expensive damage is removed - the poll loop treated any error as fatal, so one failed read abandoned a generation already running and paid for, and because the runner threw, evidence capture and cleanup never ran. Both poll loops now tolerate five consecutive failed reads (about half a minute at the default interval) and still fail promptly on a genuinely broken endpoint. Two tests pin the recovery and the give-up. Reopen if it recurs; the log will say which of the five causes it was.

The measurement this ticket has waited for since 2026-06 cannot be taken, for a reason nobody had checked: as of 2026-08-12 public.career_playbook_sources has never held a single row, and 0 of the 9 playbooks in the database use business_context mode company_specific. Source evidence is injected into exactly two prompts, spec-builder and follow-up-questions, and both only in company_specific mode - so DEFAULT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_TOKEN_BUDGET = 250_000 has never once been exercised in production. There is no cost or latency history to compare, and the concern is entirely hypothetical today. The 2026-07-03 static analysis stands on its own terms (block/group generation and regeneration inject no evidence at all, so there was never anything to shrink there; the follow-up-questions path really does reuse the full 250k default with no override, at service.ts:589, alongside the structured digest), but tuning an unexercised path on speculation is what that same note explicitly refused to do, and narrowing evidence for the first real company_specific user would be an invisible regression. Instead the path is now instrumented: buildLoadedSourceEvidence logs source count, budget, actual pack tokens and whether truncation fired, labelled by consuming phase. The first genuine company_specific run therefore produces the measurement automatically, with no deliberate experiment and no extra spend. Reopen with those numbers if the pack turns out large; the one-line override is still the fix and the owner still owns the cost-versus-quality call.

Сделано 2026-08-22. Три шага задачи закрыты, и по дороге нашлось четвёртое.

ШАГ 1 — распределение снято. 1302 сохранённых вердикта одиночного судьи: min 0.520, p10 0.700, медиана 0.820, p90 0.880, max 0.930. Доля, уходящая на коллегию, по порогу: 0.85 -> 65.4 %, 0.82 -> 49.8 %, 0.80 -> 45.5 %, 0.78 -> 32.9 %, 0.75 -> 24.3 %, 0.70 -> 9.8 %.

ШАГ 2 — что значит 'уверенный вердикт'. Из трёх условий приёмки работало одно. Нижняя ветвь score < 1 - threshold не сработала НИ РАЗУ за 1302 вердикта (минимум по истории 0.520) — снята: она не была страховкой, она делала одностороннее правило похожим на полосу, из-за чего порог и оказался на медиане. Проверка confidence >= medium оставлена: она тоже пока не отсекла ничего (1027 high, 275 medium, low не встречается), но это настоящий страж, а не недостижимое условие.

ШАГ 3 — порог 0.80 -> 0.75. Выбран не круглым числом: 0.75 — ближайшее к проектной цели каскада 15-20 %, подходящее к ней сверху (24,3 %), и остаётся выше p10, так что слабый хвост сохраняет второе мнение. 0.70 ушёл бы ниже цели и добавил мало.

ЧЕТВЁРТОЕ, ЧЕГО В ЗАДАЧЕ НЕ БЫЛО. У одиночного судьи и у коллегии были РАЗНЫЕ промпты. В промпте коллегии три проверки, которых у одиночного не было: что упражнения и вывод относятся к этому уроку, что в прозу не затесался CJK или арабица, и что урок не вдвое короче заявленной длительности. То есть дешёвый вход каскада спрашивал МЕНЬШЕ, чем коллегия за ним, — и в одиночку закрывал 37 % уроков. Промпт теперь один (buildSingleJudgePrompt делегирует в buildJudgePrompt; типы входа структурно совпадают).

И только поэтому стало законным ПЯТОЕ: коллегия больше не судит урок дважды. Одиночный проход — это и есть голос secondary: та же модель, тот же урок, теперь тот же промпт. Он передаётся в executeCLEVVoting третьим аргументом и засчитывается как голос вместо того, чтобы быть вынесенным заново. Токены реиспользованного вердикта не считаются повторно.
